explanation: A prophet and judge in Israel who led the Israelites to victory over the Canaanites.
An Israeli military leader who, together with Deborah, defeated the army of the Canaanites under Sisera.
The commander of the Canaanite forces who was defeated by Barak and Deborah. He was killed by Jael while seeking shelter in her tent.
A woman from the Kenite people who killed Sisera by driving a tent peg through his head while he slept.
A people group who lived in Canaan, an area later known as Israel and Palestine. They were enemies of the Israelites in the book of Judges 4.
A river in Canaan where the battle between the Israelites and the Canaanites took place. The river played a key role in the Israelite victory.
A leader in ancient Israel who held both political and religious authority. Deborah was such a judge.
A person who receives and delivers messages from God. Deborah was also a prophet.
